== English Decipher comparison ==
The 2015 PC replacement limits the movement surcharge to use of Jabba's own landspeed. Decipher's earlier entries were rulings. Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=77 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 77. Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=5 Glossary Supplement], PDF page 5. The 1998 ruling quotes +1. The original face and the 2002 ruling both say +2. Players Committee, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=930210#p930210 Jabba The Hutt errata], 2 February 2015. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=4 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 4. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=118 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 118.
